_comment: Reference values for rdkit-reaction-enumerate (RDKit 2024.9.5, amide SMARTS x 5 acids x 6 amines, sanitize -> InChIKey dedup -> MW[150,350]/rot<=8 filter). Deterministic; calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: Verifier replays the full enumeration pipeline and compares the kept set exactly (stereo included, order-independent) plus all five counts; refs pin the counts as drift anchors. n_raw(35) > n_unique(30): the symmetric bifunctional ethylenediamine yields duplicate products collapsed by InChIKey. 5 oracle runs identical (spread 0). Asset integrity: sha256 of both assets pinned and validated before replay (P2 B1 convention); cheat_asset_tamper.sh confirms a tampered library is a hard fail.
